lines.trans: Ye-jin—since that new apartment of yours was remodeled as a showroom unit, you did not spend much on the interior, right?
Out of nowhere… yeah, that is true.
Let us lease out that apartment to a tenant.
What?! Wait why—why would I lease it out?
Because I do not want you moving into that place.
